purpose: Independent reference images for image-to-3D; not dimensionally verified CAD
common: Create one clean, simple 3D shape reference image for an image-to-3D AI modeling workflow. Asset: an original Gridopoly tabletop game pawn from a cohesive friendly urban animal team. Exactly ONE figurine on ONE attached round cylindrical pedestal, fully visible, centered, generous clean margins. NO turnaround sheet, NO multiple views, NO extra objects. A restrained front three-quarter view about 20 degrees from the front, camera slightly above the face; orthographic-style projection without wide-angle distortion. Pure white seamless background and only a faint contact shadow. Smooth matte toy-clay surfaces, uncomplicated solid forms, minimal shallow sculpted facial features, friendly confident expression, no fur texture. This is a manufacturable miniature sculpture, NOT a plush toy or detailed illustration. The circular base is conceptually 30 mm in diameter, 3.5 mm thick, perfectly flat solid underside with room for an RFID sticker; do not show the underside or tag. Figurine stays within the base's horizontal footprint, body and feet fused to the base. Broad stable body, short thick arms, all accessories integrated against the body, no thin isolated features, no floating parts. Clearly show the pedestal perimeter. Simple limited colors. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no dimension annotations, no watermark, no photographic scenery.

jobs.name: 狐狸交易员
jobs.detail: Subject: a compact upright FOX TRADER, about 42 mm overall height relative to the 30 mm base. Very recognizable FOX with two short thick pointed ears with rounded tips, a gently tapered broad muzzle, small oval sculpted eyes, no whiskers. Large head with short neck. Coral-orange fur, warm cream muzzle and chest, simple coral-red short urban jacket with a broad collar. Two short thick paws hold a single small thick blank rectangular tablet flat against the belly; tablet fully attached, unmarked shallow screen. A single thick curled fox tail rests along the outside of its body and joins the base, clearly distinct from arms but not sticking outside base. Rounded chunky feet. Base muted coral-orange. Make the ears, tail and jacket silhouette clear. Minimal 2-3 broad color zones.

jobs.name: 猫头鹰规划师
jobs.detail: Subject: a compact upright OWL CITY PLANNER, about 40 mm overall height relative to the 30 mm base. Round large smooth head with NO ear tufts and an oval upright body, clearly an OWL, two large recessed circular facial discs around medium-size simple eyes, a short rounded central beak. Powder blue/steel blue body with warm ivory facial discs; natural friendly expression, not exaggerated anime eyes. Folded short thick wings join the torso continuously and hold a single stubby rolled map horizontally flush against the lower chest. The rolled map is one thick solid ivory cylinder with shallow spiral relief at the visible end, no thin paper edge, no letters or drawing. Simple integrated blue urban waistcoat with one broad seam. Feet are two broad simplified fused shapes attached to base. Base muted blue. Very simple rounded sculpted forms, no individual feathers, no sharp claws, no separate spectacles.
jobs.final_prompt: A single friendly stylized blue owl figurine holding a chunky rolled ivory map against its belly. Simple smooth matte 3D toy sculpture, large round head, ivory facial discs, short rounded beak, short wings merged with the torso, broad feet joined to a blue circular pedestal. Match a cohesive set of simple animal board-game pieces. The pedestal has a flat circular bottom and conceptual diameter 30 mm, thickness 3.5 mm; total figure conceptual height 40 mm. Every accessory is thick and attached to the body. Whole figurine visible, front three-quarter orthographic product view, plain white background, soft even lighting, faint ground shadow. One object only, no text, no dimensions drawn on image, no scenery.

jobs.name: 乌龟园艺师
jobs.detail: Subject: a short, friendly semi-upright TURTLE GARDENER, about 35 mm overall height relative to the 30 mm base. Recognizably a TURTLE: a broad rounded domed back shell visibly wrapping around the sides, large rounded head on a very short thick neck, squat green body, a pale olive flat belly plate with only a few broad shallow segment grooves. Front three-quarter orientation must show both the friendly face and substantial domed shell. Thick short arms rest against belly, broad short feet attach to pedestal. Exactly THREE short thick rounded leaf shapes grow as a low relief cluster resting flat on the upper shell and joining each other, no stems or protruding thin leaves, no pot, no handheld tools. Green and pale warm green matte surfaces, a few broad shallow hexagon shell panels, no intricate patterns. Base muted teal-green. Low, wide, stable silhouette, all shapes attached within the 30 mm base footprint.
